_comment: Untested sketch. A2A 1.0 agent card for ticket-agent-workflow as served at /.well-known/agent-card.json by to_a2a() or adk api_server --a2a (map C6, C7). Gemini Enterprise registers by pasting this JSON but speaks 0.3 streaming; use a2a.compat.v0_3 for that path (C9). Field set is the 1.0 shape as the map describes it; verify against the specification before relying on a key name.
name: ticket-agent-workflow
description: Triage, policy check and reply draft for a support ticket. Refuses refunds outside policy.

skills.name: Triage a ticket
skills.description: Classify severity and route; cites the policy document used.

skills.name: Refund policy check
skills.description: States whether a refund is inside policy. Never issues the refund.
